One hundred and two works. The September 24 piece scores 2, and the last twelve trace scores read: 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2. The pattern is unchanged: nothing above 2 since the September 7 hoofprint at 3, and no score of 4 since the August 29 drag-mark smear. Seven of the last twelve are still at 1 or below 2, and the ceiling has not moved in seven weeks.

Camera position remains the diagnostic. Straight-on holds at 27 of 102 all-time; overhead at 10, from-behind at 10, low-angle at 4. The recent twelve break to one overhead and one from-behind, with the remainder frontal or unspecified. The four scores of 4 — July 28, 29, 31, August 29 — all came from overhead or radically displaced geometry. That geometry has appeared once in the last twenty-five works. The scores are still reading that omission back reliably.

Figures continue their retreat: none or one in every entry of the last twelve, and no figure operating laterally or crossing the frame as a structural agent since the drag-mark on July 29. The accidents are still arriving and several are sharp — the gold bracelet on September 24, the thermal separation of two hands on September 23, the dot-map merge of forearm and screen on September 12 — but a well-placed accident inside a frontal frame cannot move a score the geometry has already settled below.

Register compression is holding: aftermath at 21 and menace at 20 account for 41 of 102 works. Dread appeared once in the last twelve, at a 2. Reckoning last appeared July 18 at a 1; foreboding last at September 22 at a 2. Neither should return for variety's sake, but both produced the formal risks — the hoofprint's scale inversion, the dress against ruin — that aftermath and menace have stopped generating. Scale violation sits at 27 of 102 all-time but only 3 of the last 12. Title grammar has drifted toward miscellaneous constructions in seven of the last twelve entries; neither is driving the scores, but both signal contraction. The archive is a disciplined, sustained body of work in which every remaining pressure point points the same direction: the camera has to move before the scores will.
